extracted.intended_audience: students, instructors, and readers of the Algebraic Topology textbook (potential downloaders and adopters)
extracted.subtask_description: Author/publisher webpage describing availability, formats, corrections, revisions, exercises, and typography for a specific Algebraic Topology textbook. Meant to guide readers on which version to use and how to obtain/print it.

rubrics_metrics.name: What's in the Book (Table of Contents and Preface)
rubrics_metrics.description: To get an idea you can look at the Table of Contents and the Preface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Table of Contents and Preface are provided as the primary quick orientation to the book's scope and intended approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printed Version — publication and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The book was published by Cambridge University Press in 2002 in both paperback and hardback editions, but only the paperback version is still available (ISBN 0-521-79540-0).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paperback price started at $30 in 2002 and has been creeping upward; less expensive printings exist for China and South Asia; a Russian translation was published in 2011.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic Version — availability and copyright terms
rubrics_metrics.description: By special arrangement with the publisher, an online version will continue to be available for free download here, subject to the terms in the copyright notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must observe the copyright notice/terms when downloading and using the online version.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic Version — layout differences and printing advice
rubrics_metrics.description: The electronic version has narrower margins than the print version for a better reading experience on portable electronic devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To restore the wider margins for printing a paper copy you can print at 85-90% of full size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole-book PDF with clickable Table of Contents (static to early-2021 corrections)
rubrics_metrics.description: The whole book as a single pdf file of about 550 pages. This now has a clickable Table of Contents created by Mat Marcus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This version does not include the small number of corrections made since early 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole-book PDF without clickable Table of Contents (kept up to date)
rubrics_metrics.description: The whole book as a single pdf file without a clickable Table of Contents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This version is kept up to date with the most recent corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual chapter PDFs and expanded Appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual chapters are available as separate pdf files. In particular there is an expanded version of the Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapters can be downloaded separately if users prefer segmented files or need the expanded appendix material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific content revisions and renumberings (section-level notes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3.2 has been revised from the original version, with a renumbering of items 3.11-3.21. Similarly, pages 352-355 in section 4.1 have been revised, with renumbering of items 4.13-4.17.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These revisions have been incorporated into reprintings of the book since 2015; note which printing/version you are using if exact numbering matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections policy and errata lists
rubrics_metrics.description: The author maintains an up-to-date list of corrections for all the errors, typographical and otherwise, that are known. There are two lists: a cumulative list covering all printings to date, and corrections to reprintings since 2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The electronic version is kept up to date to include corrections as they come to light; users should consult the errata lists to ensure they have recent fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisions and Additions (online-first updates)
rubrics_metrics.description: A number of small changes have been made in the text since first publication; these are included in the online version and eventually make their way into later printings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Revisions and Additions page for details; additional exercises are also available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercises — solutions not provided
rubrics_metrics.description: The author has not written up solutions to the exercises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reason given: the book is used as a textbook at universities where problem sets count toward student grades. Instructors and students should not expect an official solutions booklet from the author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typography notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Some comments on how the book was made to look the way it does can be found (typography page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typography commentary is available for readers interested in the production choices (margins, typesetting, layout) used in the book.
